_comment: Built-in rules for loose model-name matching. Each group's pattern is a regex fragment matched against whole '_'-separated tokens of a lowercased file stem (consecutive tokens may be glued, e.g. fp4mixed). Users can switch groups off and add their own words via 'Model Name Rules' in the canvas menu (stored in model_matching_rules.local.json).

ignore_groups.label: Precision: fp4, fp8, fp16, fp32, bf16, f16, half
FP variants: e4m3fn, e5m2, nvfp4, mxfp4, scaled, mixed
Integer quant: int4, int8, nf4, w4a16, w8a8, convrot
GGUF quant: Q4_K_M, Q8_0, IQ4_XS, gguf
Quant tools: svdq, awq, gptq, bnb
File extensions inside names: safetensors, ckpt, pt, pth, bin, sft
Misc: fast, pruned, ema, noema, fullema, comfy, converted, txtattn
